# Bilingual HAZWOPER

> HAZWOPER training for employers with English- and Spanish-speaking crews: 40-hour in Spanish, 40-hour in English, refresher, supervisor and awareness, with guides and an English-Spanish glossary.

Bilingual HAZWOPER (https://bilingual.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs 40-Hour · Español, 40-Hour · English, Supervisor, 8-Hour Refresher or related training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://bilingual.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Guides

- [Training Spanish-speaking crews: what OSHA expects](https://bilingual.hazwoperosha.us/guides/training-spanish-speaking-crews): OSHA's policy on training language, and how employers with mixed crews put it into practice.
- [Running tailgate meetings in two languages](https://bilingual.hazwoperosha.us/guides/bilingual-tailgate-meetings): A daily briefing only protects the workers who understood it. Tips for bilingual supervisors.
- [HAZWOPER terms in English and Spanish](https://bilingual.hazwoperosha.us/guides/hazwoper-glossary-english-spanish): A quick glossary of common site terms for bilingual crews and supervisors.
